title: 145 · Three-machine cel-shaded robot combination

provenance: Independent time-driven Canvas 3D polygon meshes: red jet, blue wheeled car, gold tracked tank, articulated transforming robot, clouds, road/desert, speed-line tunnels, radial finish, Japanese captions and camera moves. No original image, video or full-frame sequence is loaded. Original soundtrack comparison only.
editable: project.json scene timing and palette;composition.js dedicated mesh geometry, hinges, formation, docking and camera.
differences: Dedicated jet/car/tank/robot geometry follows the observed parts and colors but does not recover original Python meshes. Vehicle body proportions, canopy, wheels/track detail, outline thickness and some polygon overlap differ.

Car and tank parts have actual parameterized shape/hinge changes into blue arm and gold leg units, but original individual panel pivots, nose separation, silhouette and intermediate orientations are approximate. No original frame/video is used.
Formation, camera push-in, head emergence and finale follow the actual chronology; camera angle, zoom, docking gaps and some hold durations differ.

Speed lines, cloud positions, road markings, desert props, radial finish, flash intensity, eye glow and captions are independently authored. The Japanese font/kerning and impact text trajectories differ.
Original reference audio is comparison-only. Browser project itself is silent.

portable_demo.textures: Original replaceable schematic assets; not the original reference artwork.
portable_demo.approval: Historical motion implementation; this portable demo is not user-approved.
